# Marketing Well

> Digital marketing services for therapists and wellness practitioners across North America. Founded by Jordan Caron, Marketing Well specializes in Google Ads management, SEO, web design, and consulting — helping therapy practices fill their calendars and grow their teams.

Marketing Well is run by Jordan Caron, a digital marketing specialist based on Salt Spring Island, British Columbia. With over 12 years of experience in Google Ads and 5+ years working exclusively with therapists and wellness practitioners, Jordan provides hands-on, ethical marketing services tailored to the mental health industry.

## Services

- [Google Ads Management](https://marketingwell.ca/google-ads-therapists): Google Ads setup and management for therapists and wellness practitioners, run by a 12-year veteran Google Ads manager.
- [Web Design for Therapists](https://marketingwell.ca/therapist-web-design): Calm, clear, and ethical web design for therapists that builds trust, supports clients, and grows practices.
- [SEO for Therapists](https://marketingwell.ca/therapy-seo): Search engine optimization to help therapy and wellness practices rank higher and generate more organic leads.
- [Digital Marketing Consulting](https://marketingwell.ca/consulting): One-on-one digital marketing consulting for therapists and wellness practitioners.

## Case Studies

- [Dr. Darren Stolow — Google Ads](https://marketingwell.ca/darren-stolow-google-ads-case-study): 113 leads generated in 8 months, 35+ converted to paying clients.
- [Still Standing Therapy — Google Ads](https://marketingwell.ca/still-standing-therapy-google-ads-case-study): 80+ leads in 8 months, practice grew from 2 to 6 counsellors.
- [Head Coach Psychology — Google Ads](https://marketingwell.ca/head-coach-google-ads-case-study): 80 leads in 1 year in Kelowna, BC.
- [Heart & Oak Therapy — SEO](https://marketingwell.ca/heart-oak-therapy-seo): 390+ leads through SEO since 2017 in Victoria, BC.
